scope: synthetic fixed-arrival deployment, all sites active; not a physical network or measured energy
input_contract: each direction total <= V, at most M occupied ticks; all inputs arrive before final release; Delta=2V
privacy_accounting: epsilon per direction = epsilon_session/(2N); fixed across policies within a scenario
public_policy: all contracts, caps, allocations and budgets fixed before private arrivals; violation/abort privacy outside certificate
cap_ablation: Every stochastic policy is evaluated both uncapped and capped at public V; same bias and risk allocation reused across cap ablation. Constant V per tick is a mandatory stronger-privacy baseline.
validation_subset: N in {3,20}, K=20, heterogeneous, epsilon_session=4; all M,rho choices; early,spread,late
heterogeneous_budget_shares: reference uniform-workflow upper cost times cycle [.90,1.15,1.30], orchestrator 1.10; synthetic stress design, not empirical energy
cost: public weighted bytes + fixed tick-awake proxy; not calibrated joules
resource_guard: batch <=512 repetitions; no per-packet output; max wall 900s
